meaning: Independent source-derived verification of checked Workflow orchestration, settlement and selected recovery using run-local Operation fixtures; never a production provider or compensation executor.
construction_slice: R08ac1: independent settlement, exact occurrence-prefix and selected recovery metadata reference. Typed value/call fixtures and public adapter integration are following slices, not covered by this foundation.
independence: Accept only a branded checked recovery policy. Derive occurrence order and compensation dependencies from its checked source, and call bindings from authored bindings. Do not call the production settlement inspector, observation evaluator, selected recovery planner, generator or generated recovery templates to obtain expected outcomes. Shared canonical JSON and SHA-256 primitives and checked-input assertions are allowed.
settlement: Inspect only closed own enumerable data metadata. Committed requires exactly status and value but value is opaque: never read nested properties, copy, coerce, validate or freeze it. Malformed return and thrown calls are indeterminate; not-started is known noncommit. Preserve the selected stage/code/continuation/cleanup contract and never infer commit truth from result validity.
occurrences: Require an exact source step prefix, not an Operation identifier set. Repeated Operation calls retain distinct occurrence identities. No event follows a terminal noncommit. A committed result validation error preserves that commit; final materialization failure is legal only after all steps committed. Neither local error invents a failed Operation or compensation eligibility.
recovery: Only committed-prefix compensations are needed. Filter dependencies to the induced needed graph, retaining sorted inactive dependencies as evidence. Topologically order active dependencies, using reverse source completion order only among ready nodes. An empty dependency list remains unconstrained. Indeterminate commit requires reconciliation and emits no recovery intent. Recovery is metadata only; no compensation is executed, registered, retried or authorized.
identities: Preserve exact observation, journal, completed-prefix, selected plan, intent and invocation digest schemas. Execution and failure occurrence identities distinguish repeat attempts. Freeze only newly owned expected metadata and already immutable checked source, never caller payloads.
input_bounds: At most 128 observations and no more than the checked step count; dense own arrays only. Closed plain objects, own enumerable data properties, no symbols/accessors. Local identities at most 256 characters and exact lowercase local-name syntax. Failure stage/code strings at most 2048 characters. This is ordinary JavaScript descriptor safety, not isolation from hostile Proxy traps.
typed_call_slice: Independently capture typed inputs and dependencies before await; retain exact UInt64, optional omission, ordered lists, canonical sets, enum/sum tags and recursively owned Entity/Value Object/Event scopes. Evaluate source argument/result expressions and compare deferred call/settlement traces against real compiled Operations. Stop at every failure position, with no extra Workflow transaction or compensation execution.
public_slice: Bind the exact checked source, descriptor, source/native import closure and current workspace. Audit source and native effects with narrowly pinned support exceptions. Finite cases and byte limits apply to the whole node; unsupported or capacity-limited Workflows remain not_evaluable, never partially certified. Add mutation witnesses for binding, ordering, await, commit classification, recovery, ownership and identity drift before enabling public rows.
foundation_tests: Exact settlement matrix, hostile metadata and opaque committed values
Every failure prefix, uncertain commit, local errors and repeated Operation occurrences
Constrained and unconstrained recovery, inactive dependencies, all three-node DAGs and declaration permutations
Independent golden assertions, production differential checks and compiled native Workflow comparisons
Mutations of settlement, occurrence, recovery and identity behavior are detected
compatibility: Add private verification definition, scaffold, reference and tests only in R08ac1. Preserve predecessor source bytes, capsule, schemas, generators, product defaults, SFOL and AlchLang. Public Workflow controls remain not_evaluable until the following slices close.
claim_ceiling: Finite local candidate evidence only. Not provider durability, atomic storage isolation, admission, publication, exactly-once delivery, release or CLI completion. R08-R18 remain separately tracked.
